findings.claim: C-018 weakens E6 by making marketplace packaging optional even though the goal requires a Claude marketplace deliverable.
findings.evidence: Goals E6 requires: "Native harness packages (Codex `.codex-plugin`, Claude `.claude-plugin` + marketplace, OpenCode plugin/npm) generated from one canonical inventory." Plan C-018 says: "Claude package (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json`, skills, optional marketplace)".
findings.suggested_fix: Make the Claude marketplace artifact a required C-018 deliverable, or explicitly amend E6 if marketplace generation is no longer in scope.

findings.claim: C-003's fail-fast acceptance criterion is too vague to enforce G3's recoverability requirement.
findings.evidence: G3 says: "Fail fast: a doomed build should not consume 331s before reporting." C-003's acceptance criterion only says: "Oversized build reports before full extraction completes," which still permits most of the 331-second extraction to occur and gives no measurable bound.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a measurable acceptance criterion, such as reporting before publication/extraction of file contents begins when the estimate already exceeds the limit, or a deterministic fixture asserting the limit is reported within a bounded phase/time budget.

findings.claim: C-018 omits the hard dependency on the completed MCP migration despite the plan stating Wave 7 must package the migrated MCP contract.
findings.evidence: Ordering rationale says: "Wave 7 after Waves 3 and 6: packages distribute the migrated MCP contract and the split skills; generating them earlier packages contracts that are about to change." But C-018 lists only: "Depends on: C-016, C-017; benefits from C-007–C-010".
findings.suggested_fix: Change C-018 dependencies to include C-010, or explicitly require C-007 through C-010 to be complete before package generation begins.
